social capital has a positive impact on the international growth performance of new technology-based firms (NTBF) in the early stage, and the positive impact of social capital on international growth is mediated by knowledge in the later stage.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
social capital has a positive effect on the international growth and performance of NTBFs.
social capital has a direct impact on the international growth in the early stages of the NTBFs and an indirect impact in the later stages of the NTBFS.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the effect and role of social capital on internationalization of NTBFs changes over time and that the relationship between knowledge and growth is likely to be strengthened by social capital over time.
social capital can be a double-edged sword, with the positive effects diminishing over time.
social capital can be both a facilitator and a hindrance of international growth.
